exclusions.source_text: History of previous cancer, except for squamous cell or basal-cell carcinoma of the skin, or any in situ carcinoma that has been completely resected, requiring therapy within the previous 2 years.
symptomatic congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association Classification Class ≥ II)
Mean resting corrected QT interval (ECG interval measured from the onset of the QRS complex to the end of the T wave) for heart rate (QTcF) \> 470 msec obtained from 3 ECGs
Known active infections (bacterial, fungal, viral including HIV positivity).
Symptomatic brain metastases or leptomeningeal involvement.
Age ≥12 (or age ≥ 20 as required by local regulation).
